'''Jon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] living in [[Coronet City]] during the the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], Jon had an argument with his [[Jon's wife|wife]] and went out to clear his head. However, he was trapped in [[Axial Park]] when the [[rocket tram]]s stopped working.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jon is mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during an ambient conversation at [[Blastfield Shipyards]] rocket tram station.
